collectible.title: Kyouko's Ribbon
collectible.subtitle: One of a kind?
collectible.text:
The way she kept talking about how special it was to her and that she never takes it off, you totally knew she would take it off.
...Or so you tell yourself.
collectible.unlock: Play a game with Kyouko where she loses.

collectible.title: Kappa Onesie
collectible.subtitle: Now you match!
collectible.text:
Kyouko handed this to you after you had to go without any pajamas of your own. It looks bizarre, but it's comfortable and sort of cute somehow.
You might be able to convince her to bring her pajamas again, too!
collectible.unlock: Go to a pajama party with Kyouko without wearing any pajamas yourself. If you really shock her, she might be willing to hook you up...

collectible.title: Masochist Cider
collectible.subtitle: For the masochist in you
collectible.text:
Kyouko handed you a can of "Masochist Cider" root beer to help you beat the heat.

"Isn't this so much more fun than putting our clothes back on?"
collectible.unlock: Take Kyouko to the beach and get naked with her.

collectible.title: Rum Raisin
collectible.text: Kyouko shared some of her favorite ice cream with you. They normally only make this stuff in winter, but Kyouko stashes it so she can eat it year round.
collectible.unlock: Make friends with Kyouko, then play with her somewhere cold and somewhere cozy.

collectible.title: Mirakurun Tickets
collectible.subtitle: The witch girl of love and justice has arrived!
collectible.text: Tickets to the latest movie in Kyouko's favorite anime series.
collectible.unlock: Play a game with Kyouko and Nadeshiko right next to each other.
